description: This Java source file defines the class ArrayOfDecimalsSerDe, which provides serialization and deserialization methods for arrays of Decimal objects, supporting different internal representations based on decimal precision and scale. It includes nested classes for handling byte array serialization of Decimal objects.

classes.name: ArrayOfDecimalsSerDe

classes.name: ArrayOfDecimalByteArrSerDe

methods.name: serializeToByteArray

methods.name: deserializeFromMemory
